item.title: A Thoughtfully Designed Home in The Growing Community of Tornagrain
item.description: Set within the carefully planned town of Tornagrain near Inverness, this modern three bedroom home offers balanced living, an enclosed garden, and strong connectivity, combining contemporary efficiency with a calm village scale setting designed for long term living.The post A Thoughtfully Designed Home in The Growing Community of Tornagrain appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Council Archaeology Fund Backs Six Orkney Projects for 2026
item.description: Six archaeology projects across Orkney will be supported in 2026 through the Council’s £40,000 Archaeology Fund, backing community led research, learning, and heritage work that continues to place Orkney’s past at the heart of its present.The post Council Archaeology Fund Backs Six Orkney Projects for 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: UK Government Sets Out Rural Growth Plans at NFUS Conference
item.description: The UK Government has outlined plans to support farmers, crofters and rural communities at the NFUS conference, highlighting closer partnership working, rural growth initiatives and new measures aimed at strengthening Scotland’s agricultural and food sectors.The post UK Government Sets Out Rural Growth Plans at NFUS Conference appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Overnight Traffic Management Planned on A9 Between Tomatin and Moy
item.description: Overnight temporary traffic signals and a convoy system will be in operation on the A9 between Tomatin and Moy from 9 February as part of dualling works, with drivers advised of possible minor delays during essential overnight maintenance.The post Overnight Traffic Management Planned on A9 Between Tomatin and Moy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Record Free Eye Tests and Prescriptions Delivered in Scotland Under SNP
item.description: Record levels of free eye tests and prescriptions are being delivered in Scotland, with new figures showing families are saving hundreds of pounds a year through SNP health policies focused on prevention, early diagnosis, and easing cost of living pressures.The post Record Free Eye Tests and Prescriptions Delivered in Scotland Under SNP appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: MacAskill Calls for Halt to Pylons Without Cheaper Energy Deal
item.description: Alba leader Kenny MacAskill has called for a halt to new electricity pylons in Scotland unless zonal pricing is introduced to deliver cheaper energy, arguing Scotland’s vast energy resources must benefit households and businesses at home.The post MacAskill Calls for Halt to Pylons Without Cheaper Energy Deal appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Sri Lankan Man Arrested After Immigration Raid on Maryburgh Stores
item.description: A Sri Lankan man has been arrested following an immigration enforcement raid at a convenience store in Maryburgh, with the Home Office confirming further investigations and potential civil penalties as part of a wider crackdown on illegal working.The post Sri Lankan Man Arrested After Immigration Raid on Maryburgh Stores appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ducati and Dainese Unveil Expedition Masters 2026 Adventure Calendar
item.description: Ducati has unveiled its Expedition Masters 2026 calendar, offering premium motorcycle travel adventures across Italy, Iceland and North America, combining iconic routes, expert guidance and immersive riding experiences on Multistrada and DesertX models.The post Ducati and Dainese Unveil Expedition Masters 2026 Adventure Calendar appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: First Minister Aligns Funding and Policy With Farming Priorities at NFUS AGM
item.description: The First Minister has outlined new funding commitments and policy stability for Scottish farming at the NFUS AGM, including support for direct payments, farm investment and rural industries aimed at strengthening agriculture and crofting through to 2030 and beyond.The post First Minister Aligns Funding and Policy With Farming Priorities at NFUS AGM appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Quiet Bungalow in The Heart of Aviemore
item.description: Set in a quiet cul de sac in Dalnabay, Aviemore, this two bedroom bungalow offers single level living, modern interiors, and easy access to village amenities and outdoor spaces within the Cairngorms National Park.The post A Quiet Bungalow in The Heart of Aviemore appeared first on The Highland Times.
